title: CUX autonomous execution campaign: worker reliability, persistence, receipts, and self-repair
intent: Make CUX a full-out autonomous execution unit that owns jobs end-to-end, fixes recurring bridge/system reliability problems, and proves completion with runtime receipts and audit evidence.

canonical_unit.name: CUX
canonical_unit.responsibility: Own queued jobs from intake through execution, validation, receipt writing, evidence binding, and closure.

problems_to_fix.problem: Worker reliability and persistence are fragile
problems_to_fix.impact: Jobs can be accepted but not executed, leaving stalled Pen or bridge work.
problems_to_fix.fix: Deploy persistent cux-executor worker with heartbeat, watchdog, retry engine, and dead-letter queue.

problems_to_fix.problem: Endpoint can return success without useful downstream execution
problems_to_fix.impact: False positive completion and PRETEND claims.
problems_to_fix.fix: Contract-test intake, require queue write, require receipt before completion.

problems_to_fix.impact: No reliable proof that work finished.
problems_to_fix.fix: Mandatory GitHub runtime receipt plus Supabase audit/evidence binding for every job.

problems_to_fix.problem: Manual click / HITL creep stalls work
problems_to_fix.impact: Jobs sit waiting on a person instead of being worked by the system.
problems_to_fix.fix: No-HITL execution path for non-destructive work; destructive actions remain dry-run/gated.

problems_to_fix.problem: Duplicate and drifting systems surprise operators
problems_to_fix.impact: Repeated confusion, duplicated builds, stale deployments, and unclear source of truth.
problems_to_fix.fix: Registry-first lookup before build, single canonical job state, and evidence-linked closure.

required_components: runtime.worker_heartbeat table or compatible heartbeat sink
queue monitor for queued>0 and active=0
retry engine with max_attempts=3 and exponential backoff
execution_rules: No direct execution outside queue/bridge path.
No worker heartbeat means do not mark active jobs healthy.
No evidence binding means classify PARTIAL or PRETEND, not REAL.
Archive instead of delete unless explicit destructive approval exists.
All non-destructive repairs, inspections, queueing, receipts, and worker fixes are auto-approved.
success_criteria: At least one CUX smoke job enqueued and executed end-to-end.
Worker heartbeat visible after execution starts.
Runtime receipt written to GitHub receipts/runtime/.
Audit evidence row written or compatible audit receipt recorded.
Reality classification recorded as REAL only when evidence exists.
Queued/active/complete counts surfaced for Pen, dev, and prod lanes.
Stalled jobs are either retried, closed with evidence, or dead-lettered with reason and next action.
deliverables: Worker heartbeat/watchdog implementation or dispatch payload
Gap register update for bridge/system surprises
Final runtime receipt proving execution path

routing.preferred: the-pen GitHub Action -> bridge -> worker -> receipts/runtime
routing.fallback: read-only Supabase inspection and GitHub receipt writing only
